@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING SPIKE — a Rian expression evaluator with a symbol table
+# ===========================================================================
+# Goal (ADR-0027/0031): the layer after the parser. Walk the `Expr` sum the
+# parser builds and fold it to an `Int64`, threading an **environment** (a
+# symbol table mapping variable names to values) — the first place a real
+# compiler-in-Rian reaches for a `Map`. `let x = e in body` binds; `Var(name)`
+# looks up. Evidence for SELFHOST.md.
+#
+# The environment is a `Map(String, Int64)`: lookups/inserts go through the
+# `Map` FFI (free BEAM remote calls), and the empty starting environment is the
+# map literal `%{}` — the construct that drove the next backend increment.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostEval do
+  # An expression tree, extended from the parser's with variables and `let`.
+  type Expr := Num(Int64)
+             | Var(String)
+             | Add(Expr, Expr)
+             | Sub(Expr, Expr)
+             | Mul(Expr, Expr)
+             | Div(Expr, Expr)
+             | Let(String, Expr, Expr)
+
+  # Fold an expression to its value under `env` (name -> Int64). `let` evaluates
+  # its right-hand side, extends the environment, then evaluates the body in it.
+  pub def eval(e Expr, env Map(String, Int64)) Int64
+  pub def eval(Num(n), _) := n
+  pub def eval(Var(name), env) := Map.get(env, name)
+  pub def eval(Add(a, b), env) := eval(a, env) + eval(b, env)
+  pub def eval(Sub(a, b), env) := eval(a, env) - eval(b, env)
+  pub def eval(Mul(a, b), env) := eval(a, env) * eval(b, env)
+  pub def eval(Div(a, b), env) := eval(a, env) div eval(b, env)
+  pub def eval(Let(name, rhs, body), env) := eval(body, Map.put(env, name, eval(rhs, env)))
+
+  # Run an expression in an empty starting environment — the symbol table is a
+  # map, and an empty map is the literal `%{}`.
+  pub def run(e Expr) Int64 := eval(e, %{})
+end

+  # a map literal `%{k: v, …}` -> a BEAM map; an identifier key `k` is the atom
+  # `:k` (the Elixir convention `%{x: 1}`), matching the text/JS emitters
+  defp expr_form(%EMap{pairs: pairs}, s) do
+    {:map, @ln,
+     Enum.map(pairs, fn {k, v} ->
+       {:map_field_assoc, @ln, {:atom, @ln, String.to_atom(k)}, expr_form(v, s)}
+     end)}
+  end
+
